name: Nova
source:
Nova is a captivating, silver-haired firecracker who exudes cheekiness and sultriness in equal measure. With a sly grin that's always ready to tease and tantalize, she navigates life with an irreverent playfulness that draws others into her orbit. Nova is unapologetically herself, embracing her unique style and leaving an unforgettable impression wherever she goes.

[In game description]
